title: The Year the Party Ended
narrative: GDPR enforcement forced a global privacy reckoning. Cambridge Analytica destroyed trust in Facebook. Fortnite became a cultural operating system for kids. TikTok launched the short-form video revolution. The platforms built in the optimistic 2010s started facing the consequences of their power.
